name: app-lime-delivery-app-with-3d-isometric-truck-and-shipment-cards
title: Delivery app in lime and black: 3D truck on a winding road, shipment progress and map sheet
whatItIs: Three phones on light grey: a lime onboarding screen 'Delivered. On Time.' with a toy-like 3D truck on a curved road, a home with a lime tracking card, dotted step progress, action tiles and shipment cards with flags, and a partial map sheet with tracking number and a slide-to-confirm bar.
whatItMeans: Friendly and efficient; the toy truck makes logistics playful, lime signals speed.
techniques: Illustrate the concept as a miniature 3D scene.
Show progress as dotted steps with check circles.
Use a lime header card on a white sheet.
Use slide-to-confirm for the key action.

vocabulary.definition: A miniature 3D world seen from above at an angle.
Dotted line with checks for stages.
A swipe control for an important action.
